title: Family Truth Reconciliation — the standing rules, and the JVM/web remainder
purpose: M14, M37 and M49 each certify the JVM and Web families as done, while 14 M49-CONV issues remain open across every family. The mechanism is scope: each milestone measured its own artifact (M14 the analyzer oracle, M37 the families against each other, M49 external claims against code) and none measured payload truth across the seam emit -> store -> query -> tool, so every new dimension looked like a new phase instead of an unfinished one. M60 closes the remainder, converts 'family closed' from prose into a computed boolean (green gate AND zero non-alive payload cells), and establishes the standing rules that bind every milestone so no new milestone is minted to carry work that belongs to an existing one. Fold target: M49. Hand-off: M14-clean receives one milestone for all remaining analyzers.
invariant: A family may be called closed only when its closure gate is green AND every payload cell of every onboarded language in it is alive — produced by the analyzer, preserved by the store, reachable at query, and truthful at the tool. Any closure claim not backed by a live gate is itself a defect. No new milestone may be created to carry work that belongs to an existing one.

Recorded rather than silently absorbed: dart's own review folder and analyzer are tracked by their own wave, and the closure conditions that read this language list (folders closed, analyzers committed, cells alive) must not be widened to languages this family does not own without that being a decision.

standingRules.rule: No new milestone for work that belongs to an existing one; findings become issues under existing milestones.
A family is closed only when its closure gate is green AND its payload matrix has zero non-alive cells.
Every finding document must be registered as an issue before it is worked. A doc is not a queue.
Fold contract: at close, M60's family results are recorded into M49 as the evidence its jvm/web closure claims are true.
M14-clean receives one milestone covering all remaining analyzers, each carrying the accumulated checks of every prior milestone.

One line base for every line in the payload: `line_number`, `range`, `decoratorLine` and the `metadata.line` mirror are 1-based, and no analyzer may emit a mirror that is not provably so (#873's class; the cpp/hpp rows carry no `line_number` at all, so the mirror was their entire line).
